decisions.reason: As a dietary supplement range that builds on the firm's established consumer-health and pharmacy-facing capabilities, it is close enough to existing knowledge for the firm to learn and improve it.
This skin and hair supplement is closely related to the firm's broadened consumer-health portfolio, so its own R&D and market experience make continued commercialization likely.
The joint health supplement builds on the firm's established offer and was given increasing website prominence, which supports keeping a related product the firm can readily understand and adjust.
Although somewhat more niche, this immune supplement still builds on the firm's established supplement line, and the firm's R&D and development capabilities favor retaining it to refine the concept.

This generic blood pressure product is described as distant from the firm's established offer and its early market phase showed a valsartan-related problem, making learning and confident continuation less attractive.

The OTC migraine triptan is marked as distant, but it still sits within the firm's broader pharmaceutical and OTC competences, so a large R&D-performing firm would be somewhat more likely to continue than to withdraw it.
